name: tmux-agentic-plugin
description: tmux status strip, picker, notifications and remote pane mirrors for coding agent sessions.

interface.shortDescription: See what every coding agent in tmux is doing.
interface.longDescription: A tmux plugin that tracks coding agents across local sessions and SSH hosts as working, ready, blocked, error or idle. Jump from the status strip or picker, get desktop notifications, and interact with remote agents in a dedicated local session with one pane mirror per agent.
